reviews.title: Doesn't last
reviews.comment: The video card died after just 8 months.  It keeps crashing my computer.  Got message that it needed to be connected the power, which it was connected.  After disconnecting the video card and used the graphic hardware on the motherboard, the crashing went away.  Not worth the risk just to save a few dollars.  Get a new one.
reviews.author: Henry C Chen
